title: VeriffSessionResponse
description: A response from asking for a session

verification.title: VeriffSessionInformation
verification.description: Information on the status and links to execute the session.

id.description: String UUID v4 which identifies the verification session

url.description: URL of the verification to which the person is redirected (Combination of the baseUrl and sessionToken)

vendorData.description: Customer-specific data string, max 1000 characters long

host.description: The base url the sessionToken can be used for
